found.quote: The University defines plagiarism as the act of presenting the work of another person (or people) and/or content generated by artificial intelligence (AI) tools, as one’s own without proper acknowledgement.
found.anchor: Plagiarism (including copying, self-plagiarism, collusion and use of generative artificial intelligence)

found.quote: Where Academic Misconduct is confirmed as a fourth formal offence, the penalty applied will always be Penalty D.

If the student fails to attend the hearing within 15 minutes of the scheduled start time without a reason that is deemed acceptable by the University, the hearing will proceed on the basis of the evidence available to the panel.

unsure.quote: which may include a copy of the Turnitin report detailing the identified sources
unsure.why: Turnitin report provided as evidence; no interpretation or restriction stated.
